config.design: Shared rank8 linear bottleneck in frozen write coordinates, fixed natural mean/global scale, initialized at original write-PCA8. Both encoder and decoder train. Same initialization, minibatch schedule,128Adamsteps and LR for reconstruction and direct KL(native||edited). Normalize each training loss by its initial first-batch value. Teacher model frozen. Final checkpoint only, no validation selection.
config.limitations: Single deterministic initialization/schedule, short pilot not convergence or tuned-objective comparison. Reused validation panel; no sparse gates, manifold or causal transfer claims. KL teacher may preserve biases/errors; observed-token CE separate.
